Architecture

Failure and recovery playbook

A visible error is preferable to a silent partial economic commit.

On this page
Client/zone/backend failuresBounded retryRepair policy

Client/zone/backend failures

ConditionRecovery contract
Missing loot/recipe/item definitionReject before commit; source remains claimable unless an explicit terminal failure policy says otherwise. Log catalog hash and missing ID.
Dead target/actor destroyedCancel pending live action; no damage/grant from later notify. Already committed receipts remain valid.
Full inventoryCompute final capacity before durable consumption. Craft/loot/vendor reject without partial effects; fishing policy records failed terminal catch without fish/XP.
Stale item GUID/quoteReject ItemChanged/StaleQuote and refresh; never substitute another owned item silently.
Equipment conflictReject two-hand/offhand or prerequisite conflict atomically; preserve previous equipment/stats.
Conversation canceled by travelInvalidate request generation, close modal and unbind; already committed consequence is recovered from durable state.
Missed animation notifyGameplay timer/authority finishes or cancels independently; cosmetic cue may be absent.
Server restart mid-fishingUnresolved attempt cancels; committed terminal catch loads once.
Disconnect after craft/trade confirmationQuery same command/trade terminal status; do not refund/grant from the client.
Corrupted backend recordQuarantine and support repair with audit, no blind deletion/default grant.
PaperZD absentStop plugin-specific animation creation; use legal debug Paper2D for physics proof only and retain blocked compatibility gate.
Unknown content versionPatchRequired or recovery before admission; no unversioned reinterpretation.

Bounded retry

Separate a validation rejection from transient infrastructure failure. Rejected commands with known terminal receipts do not need automatic loops. Transient service retries keep the same key and bounded backoff; UI supplies cancel/help after a clear threshold. Cancellation of an uncertain request is not proof it was never committed.

Repair policy

Operators inspect immutable receipt/ledger/source claims and current session epoch. Corrections are new auditable administrative commands with reason and reviewer, not manual silent edits through a client console. Test the repair on staging and preserve pre-repair evidence. Sensitive logs remain private.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
